root_family.canonical_name: Retail Point of Sale (POS), Cash Registers & Store Fixtures
root_family.definition: Fiscal electronic cash registers (ERCA certified F-POS), barcode laser scanners, thermal receipt printers, and supermarket shelving gondolas.

translations.am: የችርቻሮ ሽያጭ መመዝገቢያ (ካሽ ሬጂስተር) እና ባርኮድ ስካነር
translations.ti: ናይ ንግዲ መመዝገቢ (ካሽ ሬጂስተር)ን ባርኮድ ስካነርን

children.canonical_name: ERCA-Certified Fiscal Electronic Cash Registers (ካሽ ሬጂስተር)
children.definition: Government-accredited electronic sales register machines (Datecs, Daisy, Tremol) with GPRS telecommunication modules.

translations.am: የገቢዎች እውቅና ያላቸው የሽያጭ መመዝገቢያ ማሽኖች (ካሽ ሬጂስተር)
translations.ti: ናይ ግብሪ ፍቓድ ዘለዎም ናይ መሸጢ ማሽናት
